description: This file defines the User entity class for the salesmanager backend, including properties such as username, email, password, associated groups, merchant store, language preferences, security questions, audit data, and login timestamps. It is mapped to the 'USER' table in the database schema.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing application users with properties such as username, email, password, roles, associated merchant, language preferences, security questions, audit info, and login timestamps. It maps to the 'USER' table.
